name: Archeio-Marxism
summary: A Greek interwar Marxist current (c. 1921-34) named after the journal Archive of Marxism. It held that revolutionary theory and cadre education must come before mass action, then aligned with Trotsky's Left Opposition: defence of the Soviet state against Stalinism, workers' democracy, soviets, a workers' and peasants' government, independent revolutionary trade unions, and turning imperialist war into civil war.
scope: The movement's core years 1921-34, from the First Core inside SEKE through EKD and KOMLEA under Tzoulatis and Giotopoulos, as documented in the 1930 congress resolution and Karliaftis's later account of the Trotskyist current. It excludes the 1934 split into KAKE and that party's later anti-communist collaboration, and the sources are thin on social and cultural questions, so most answers are inferred from the Left Opposition and Comintern framework the movement adopted.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: A Marxist group in the Left Opposition tradition rejects capitalist market allocation and calls for expropriation and planning.

public-ownership.rationale: Its programme followed the first four Comintern congresses, which call for nationalising key industries under workers' control.

unions-good.rationale: The movement built influence in the unions and demanded a unified revolutionary trade union organisation against the KKE's rival unions.

property-fundamental.rationale: As a communist group it aimed at abolishing bourgeois property in the means of production, so it rejects this right as a fundamental one.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Marxists see regulation as a reformist palliative rather than a goal; adherents would call for expropriation, so neither agree nor disagree is clean.

worker-ownership.rationale: Calls for soviets and workers' control; Karliaftis says Stalin abolished workers' control, implying the Trotskyists upheld it.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: No documented view; a Marxist group would distrust bourgeois state censorship but oppose racism, so genuinely uncertain.

strong-leader.rationale: Opposed Stalin's Bonapartist personal rule and championed workers' democracy and soviets.

state-harmful.rationale: Marxism-Leninism holds that the workers' state is needed during the transition; the group wanted a workers' government, not a stateless order.

gradual-change.rationale: The movement called for revolution and a workers' government and condemned the reformists.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: It was hostile to the League of Nations style bourgeois bodies and pinned hopes on the revolutionary International instead.

free-trade.rationale: Marxist analysis of imperialism sees free trade as serving capital, and the group called for a socialist economy.

nation-first.rationale: Rejected national framing of the occupation and favoured international class solidarity.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Opposed imperialist wars and held that powers' wars serve capital, so military intervention is not accepted.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: Marxism holds technology creates the material basis for socialism but not that it alone solves problems, so adherents would split.

revolution-justified.rationale: The 1930 congress resolution aims at revolutionary education and condemns the KKE's adventures, while seeking a revolutionary party; Karliaftis speaks of civil war and a workers and peasants government.

central-planning.rationale: Followed the Left Opposition, which defended the planned economy of the USSR and championed planning.

land-value-tax.rationale: A Georgist reform is foreign to Marxism, which wants socialisation of land rather than a tax replacement.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Rejects nationalist economic framing, though it may see protection as a tactical question; undocumented.

widespread-small-property.rationale: Marxism seeks socialised ownership, not the spread of small property.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Nulled (statement review, 2026-11-11): its rationale is about abolishing wage labour, not money, and the statement now asks only about money; wage labour has its own statement.

reviewHistory.rationale: Marxism's final communist aim is the abolition of wage labour, though adherents treat it as long-term only.
reviewHistory.author: claude-sonnet-5-5

reviewHistory.rationale: Nulled (statement review, 2026-11-11): its rationale is about abolishing wage labour, not money, and the statement now asks only about money; wage labour has its own statement.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: Trotskyist programme calls for merging banks into a state credit body, not abolishing central banking to market money.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: Opposed class collaboration and the corporatist state; stressed independent working-class organisation.

one-party-rule.rationale: Karliaftis condemns Stalin for destroying democracy and the Trotskyists defended workers' democracy.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: A revolutionary communist group rejects monarchy; Greece had a restored monarchy debate in 1935, and it favoured workers' government.

democracy-best.rationale: It criticised the Venizelos 'democratic' dictatorship yet defended workers' democracy, so a literal answer on bourgeois democracy is split.

workers-councils.rationale: Karliaftis says guerrilla war ignored the soviets, the basis of a worker and peasant united front, and the group opposed the destruction of workers' control.

right-to-secede.rationale: The group rejected the KKE's Macedonia and Thrace slogan as unrealistic, but the Leninist right of self-determination remains; undecided.

natural-rulers.rationale: Marxism rejects innate fitness to rule; a class view of authority.

political-violence-never.rationale: Revolutionary group that spoke of civil war and rejected pacifism.

war-builds-character.rationale: Opposed imperialist war and sought its conversion into civil war.

separate-church-state.rationale: Communist groups demand separation of church and state as an elementary democratic task.

military-superiority.rationale: Anti-militarist and defeatist toward its own government in imperialist wars.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Internationalist class politics; it rejected the national framing of the occupation.

class-struggle-history.rationale: Marxist premise; the 1930 resolution assumes revolutionary working-class struggle against the bourgeoisie.

civilizational-union.rationale: Karliaftis stresses international class struggle and rejects national framings; uniting states by religion or civilization cuts across class lines.

self-interest-moral.rationale: Marxist ethics reject bourgeois egoism; communist solidarity is the norm.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: Marxism treats industrial capitalism as progressive material basis for socialism.

restore-past-order.rationale: A revolutionary group seeking socialism opposes restoration.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Its motto first education and then action stresses theory before practice, which counts against pragmatism.

means-match-ends.rationale: Marxists generally hold ends justify means in class struggle, but this is an inference.

return-to-foraging.rationale: Marxist view of historical progress rejects primitivism.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: Marx's long-term aim; the group's own view is undocumented.

distribute-by-need.rationale: Marxist communist principle 'to each according to need' followed the Comintern programme, though in transition by work.

production-for-use.rationale: Standard Marxist goal of replacing capitalist production for profit.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Karliaftis says the unfinished bourgeois-democratic tasks in Greece could be solved only by a proletarian dictatorship on the model of the Permanent Revolution. The sources set out the underlying principle but do not state a position on this specific statement.

collective-farming.rationale: The Trotskyists sought a workers and peasants government; the Left Opposition criticised forced collectivisation; position unsettled.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: Karliaftis frames the war as imperialist and calls for converting it into civil war.

taxation-theft.rationale: Marxist programmes treat taxation of the bourgeoisie as legitimate and look to a workers' state financing planned production, so this libertarian claim is rejected.

individual-rights-only.rationale: Marxism criticises abstract individual rights, but the group's views on rights are undocumented.

conscription.rationale: Anti-militarist toward its own government; Trotskyists favoured a workers' militia in revolutionary conditions, so only a weak lean.

exit-over-voice.rationale: Contradicts workers' democracy emphasis on political participation.

state-as-business.rationale: Marxist rejection of market logic in the state.

positive-liberty.rationale: Marxist tradition holds formal freedom is empty without material means, as in its criticism of formal democracy.

media-academia-power.rationale: Marxists see ownership of capital as the real power, not media and academia.

organic-representation.rationale: Corporatist concept contrary to class politics.

total-state.rationale: Condemned Stalin's Bonapartist regime that suppressed workers' democracy.

national-rebirth.rationale: National rebirth is a fascist theme opposed by internationalist Marxists.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Anti-imperialist and opposed to wars between powers.

personal-loyalty-rule.rationale: Feudal concept rejected by a Marxist movement.

single-common-good.rationale: Marxists reject a classless common good in class society.

workplace-democracy.rationale: Workers' control and soviets were central; Stalin's abolition of workers' control is condemned.

school-vouchers.rationale: Public money for private school choice runs against the socialised provision a revolutionary Marxist group would want, and the Comintern tradition demanded secular state schools. None of the cited sources takes up this statement, so this is a low-confidence reading of the general outlook.

economic-freedom.rationale: Contradicts Marxist view that capitalist economic freedom underpins class rule.

rule-by-example.rationale: Confucian idea unrelated to its materialist politics.

national-self-determination.rationale: Leninist tradition supports it, yet the group rejected the KKE's Macedonian independence slogan and the national-liberation framing of the occupation.

force-without-un.rationale: Karliaftis describes opposing imperialist war by turning it into civil war; a state's unilateral force abroad is rejected whether or not a UN body approves.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Its motto first education then action reflects rationalism, and Marxism is secular.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: Class internationalism rejects dividing workers by nationality. None of the cited sources takes up this statement, so this is a low-confidence reading of the general outlook.

class-collaboration.rationale: Opposed collaboration with the bourgeoisie and the reformists and advocated a united workers' front.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: A group whose motto was education before action prized study and the cultural inheritance of Marxism; destroying libraries is a Futurist idea it would not share. None of the cited sources takes up this statement, so this is a low-confidence reading of the general outlook.

dominated-front.rationale: Anti-imperialist logic favours the colonised but it rejects national fronts; the group's position is unclear.

workers-nation.rationale: The movement stood for the working class as an international class; Karliaftis rejects national framing even of the occupation.

state-class-instrument.rationale: Standard Marxist-Leninist theory, applied to the Venizelos government which the resolution calls a democratic dictatorship.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Class internationalism opposes nationalist pressure, but undocumented.

elite-replacement.rationale: Conspiracy theory incompatible with materialist class analysis.

national-mission.rationale: Anti-imperialist and opposed to promoting a national form of government.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Marxist-Leninist tradition accepted women's oppression but the group's views are undocumented.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Nationalisation of key industries and a planned economy contradict a state limited to defence and property protection.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Racial doctrine contradicts the universalist materialism of Marxism, which the movement held.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Marxist egalitarian humanism, though it stresses class not formal rights.

socialism-one-country.rationale: The 1930 resolution says the movement agreed with the Left Opposition on the Chinese Revolution, the Anglo-Russian Committee and Socialism in one country, all as critiques.

restrict-conversion.rationale: A secularist Marxist group opposes state regulation of religious belief.

ban-cattle-slaughter.rationale: A religious-sentiment law foreign to Marxist materialism; not relevant to Greece.

no-religion-state-schools.rationale: Standard communist demand for secular schooling.

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: Left Opposition criticised Stalinist bureaucratic strengthening of the state and held that workers' democracy, not a stronger apparatus, defends the USSR.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Workers' democracy stresses mass consent, but the group's wording is class based, so a weak inference.

trade-surplus.rationale: Mercantilist national goal contrary to internationalism.

population-transfer.rationale: Pressuring a minority to leave contradicts working-class internationalism, which Karliaftis's account of the group maintains.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: Revolutionary group that endorses revolutionary civil war.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Marxism holds class struggle, not social Darwinist competition, drives change. None of the cited sources takes up this statement, so this is a low-confidence reading of the general outlook.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: Revolutionaries oppose bourgeois state banning parties, as it would be used against workers; undocumented.

separated-powers.rationale: Soviet power unites legislative and executive functions; the group favoured soviets over bourgeois checks.

vanguard-party.rationale: Its 1930 congress debated forming a new Communist party and stressed ideological preparation of cadres; its early education-first motto reflects the need for trained leadership.

priority-to-poor.rationale: Class-based politics prioritises workers and the poor.

right-to-buy-council-homes.rationale: Council housing sales are a later British policy; no basis in the sources for an answer.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: It built influence in the unions; strikes are a core instrument.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: Marxists attribute poverty to the social system, not to population.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Class internationalism rejects ethnic cohesion arguments.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: It opposed Stalin's repression and criticised bourgeois emergency rule, though revolutionary dictatorship limits rights for former ruling classes.

party-controls-media.rationale: The Trotskyists condemned Stalinist suppression of workers' democracy.

party-commands-army.rationale: Left Opposition criticised the bureaucratic party-state; undocumented here.

long-naturalization-wait.rationale: Nationalist restriction conflicts with internationalism; undocumented.

representatives-worker-pay.rationale: Paris Commune principle; supporters shouted 'Long live the Commune' at Trotsky's 1932 visit.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: Leninist democratic centralism followed from the first four Comintern congresses.

head-commands-forces.rationale: Contradicts workers' democracy and the soviet principle.

church-by-bishops.rationale: Not relevant; secular Marxists oppose Church authority in the state.

clerical-rule.rationale: Rule by religious scholars contradicts the secular, materialist outlook of a communist movement.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: Karliaftis says the Trotskyists called for transforming the imperialist war into civil war instead of backing their own government. The sources set out the underlying principle but do not state a position on this specific statement.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: Trotsky's tradition defended freedom of art; undocumented for this group.

recall-officials.rationale: Soviet democracy and the Paris Commune model, which the movement's supporters acclaimed, make delegates removable at any time.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Opposed imperialist alliances and wars, but not directly documented.

abolish-rental-housing.rationale: Not a Marxist demand; socialisation of housing rather than universal home ownership.

people-in-arms.rationale: Trotskyist programme favours workers' militias, but this group's text is silent. None of the cited sources takes up this statement, so this is a low-confidence reading of the general outlook.

rural-life-healthier.rationale: Marxist rejection of rural idyll; the group also held Greece capitalist.

reunify-divided-nation.rationale: Rejected nationalist slogans such as the KKE's Macedonia line.

educated-out-of-touch.rationale: Its education-first ethos valued intellectual preparation.

death-penalty.rationale: No Archeio-Marxist text on capital punishment was found; the lean follows the Trotskyist opposition to bourgeois courts.

creationism-in-schools.rationale: Teaching creationism contradicts the materialist science and secular schooling a communist group upheld.

minority-language-support.rationale: It rejected the Macedonian independence slogan but the Leninist tradition supports minority language rights.

independence-needs-economic-change.rationale: Karliaftis: bourgeois-democratic tasks require proletarian dictatorship; permanent revolution links political to economic transformation.

constituent-assembly.rationale: Trotskyists often supported democratic slogans as transitional but the group's stance is unrecorded.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: Condemned Stalin's destruction of democracy during industrialisation.

central-bank-independence.rationale: Marxist programme subordinates banking to a workers' state.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: Weaker than the Marxist abolition of private property in production, so agreeing weakly at best.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: Karliaftis says Trotskyists defended the Soviet Union and called Stalin's regime Bonapartist, not capitalist.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: Anti-clerical communist inclination, but the group never recorded this.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: Leninist right of self-determination; undocumented for the group.

sacred-ruler.rationale: A divine-descent ruler contradicts materialist communism outright.

character-from-environment.rationale: Marxist materialism holds that social conditions shape people.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: Karliaftis calls Stalin's regime Bonapartist for destroying democracy; the movement opposed rulers unbound by workers' control.

mixed-constitution.rationale: The movement sought soviet power by the working class, not a balance of few and many.

leader-cult.rationale: The movement attacked Stalin's Bonapartist personal rule, and the Left Opposition opposed his cult.

class-struggle-under-socialism.rationale: Left Opposition held bureaucracy threatens the revolution, and Karliaftis calls Stalin's regime Bonapartist.

land-redistribution.rationale: Calls for a workers' and peasants' government, which in Greece meant solving agrarian tasks.

co-ethnic-territorial-claim.rationale: Karliaftis reports rejection of nationalist territorial slogans such as the KKE's Macedonia line, so irredentism on grounds of nationality is opposed.

women-must-cover.rationale: Compelled dress contradicts the secular emancipatory outlook of a communist movement.

kin-peoples-union.rationale: Political unity by language family and ancestry cuts across class internationalism.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: Historical materialism is central to Marxism, and the movement worked from the first four Comintern congresses.

ban-cartels.rationale: Marxists see concentration as a stage towards socialisation, not something to break up.

no-bailouts.rationale: Marxists oppose bailing out capital but also failures hit workers; split.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: The resolution criticises the KKE's Third Period line for leading workers astray into adventures.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: Imperial tutelage is rejected by a movement in the anti-imperialist Marxist tradition that Karliaftis describes.

patriotic-education.rationale: Nationalist loyalty teaching conflicts with class internationalism, which Karliaftis's account of the movement presents.

capitalism-adapts.rationale: Revolutionary Marxism holds capitalism cannot escape crisis; the resolution called for revolution.

former-empire-influence.rationale: Seeking influence in former imperial territories is imperialist and contrary to the movement's stance.

delink-world-market.rationale: Permanent revolution thesis stresses world economy, not autarky.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: Contradicts equal rights and opposes unfettered property rights.

elective-rulers.rationale: Workers' democracy and the election of delegates are the movement's model, and Karliaftis condemns Stalin for abolishing them.

minority-veto.rationale: Leninist democratic centralism, taken from the first four Comintern congresses, binds minorities after debate.

resist-lawless-ruler.rationale: Revolutionary stance, but this is liberal-constitutionalist wording.

parliament-supreme.rationale: Soviets, not parliaments, are the model; the group opposed bourgeois democracy.

noblesse-oblige.rationale: Rejects paternalism of the privileged; class struggle instead.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: Its early educational circles still aimed at action; it is a political movement.

mass-culture-pacifies.rationale: Marxist ideology critique, undocumented for the group.

native-born-offices.rationale: Restricting offices to native-born citizens contradicts the class internationalism of the movement.

party-own-road.rationale: Opposed the national-road logic of Stalinism; Left Opposition emphasised international revolution and its Third International orientation.

return-lost-territory.rationale: Karliaftis reports opposition to nationalist territorial slogans and a refusal of national-liberation framing, so war-loss revanchism is rejected.

totalitarianisms-equivalent.rationale: The Trotskyists defended the USSR as a worker state against capitalism, rejecting equivalence with fascism.

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: The movement held universalist class politics and a workers' state model, rejecting civilizational exceptionalism.

military-guardian-role.rationale: Hostile to the bourgeois army's political role.

no-fault-divorce.rationale: Communist tradition liberalised divorce, undocumented here.

recallable-delegates.rationale: The Commune principle of delegates bound by instructions and removable is central to the soviets the movement defended.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: Privatising social insurance contradicts socialisation. None of the cited sources takes up this statement, so this is a low-confidence reading of the general outlook.

single-official-language.rationale: Karliaftis's account of the group stresses internationalism, and the Leninist tradition favours minority language rights, so this leans disagree.

intervene-in-bloc.rationale: Invading an allied state to stop it leaving a bloc is imperialist aggression, which the movement opposed.

corporate-influence.rationale: Marxist view of state-capital ties; the resolution calls the Greek state a bourgeois dictatorship.

democratic-peace.rationale: Imperialist wars between democracies are exactly what capitalism causes.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: Revolutionaries deny the bourgeois state's legitimacy, undocumented directly.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: Conspiracy theories about ethnic minorities are incompatible with a materialist class analysis.

informal-organisation.rationale: It favoured a revolutionary party and cadres.

religious-nation.rationale: Defining a nation by religion contradicts the group's secular class internationalism.

deference-to-leading-power.rationale: Tribute to a hegemon contradicts the anti-imperialist outlook described in Karliaftis.

regional-revenue-retention.rationale: Regional fiscal separatism cuts against a centralised planned economy, though the group did not address it.

personal-possessions-private.rationale: Standard Marxist distinction between personal and productive property.

defeat-communism.rationale: The movement was itself communist and aimed at a revolutionary workers' state.

religion-illusion.rationale: Marxist view of religion, though its stance as a Greek group is not directly sourced.

capitalism-progressive.rationale: Karliaftis holds Greece was capitalist and unfinished bourgeois tasks existed; classical Marxism sees capitalism as historically progressive.

women-equality-needs-economic-change.rationale: Marxist-Leninist view, undocumented for the group.

cooperative-communities.rationale: Rejects utopian small-community socialism for revolutionary state power.

majority-settlement.rationale: State-led settlement against minorities contradicts the class internationalism of the movement.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: The movement was a communist one in the Comintern lineage and rejected any third course.

historical-land-claim.rationale: Historic claims to territory are nationalist arguments the group's internationalism would not endorse, though undiscussed.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Karliaftis criticises Stalin for destroying democracy.

punish-blasphemy.rationale: Punishing blasphemy contradicts the secularism of a communist movement.

colonies-serve-metropole.rationale: The movement's anti-imperialism opposes governing colonies for the metropole's benefit.

defensive-jihad-duty.rationale: A religious duty doctrine is foreign to the materialist Marxism of the movement.

unreligious-rulers-fought.rationale: Theocratic doctrine is foreign to Marxism and contradicts the movement's secular outlook.

left-right-obsolete.rationale: Class politics opposes combining left and right.

alienated-labor.rationale: Alienation of labour is part of the classical Marxist critique of capitalism that the movement studied before acting.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: Authority from God contradicts materialist and secular communism; the movement sought workers' power.

ban-nda-harassment.rationale: A modern workplace-law question absent from the sources.

social-market-economy.rationale: The group rejected reformist and social-democratic politics.

rich-first.rationale: Allowing some to grow rich first is Deng-style and contradicts the egalitarianism and permanent revolution of the movement.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Anti-imperialist and defeatist stance toward blocs; not explicit.

dynastic-succession.rationale: Hereditary succession contradicts the workers' democracy the movement defended against Stalin's rule.

interest-free-mutual-credit.rationale: Mutualist alternative; Marxists seek nationalised banking.

property-franchise.rationale: The movement stood for workers' democracy and soviets, and a property franchise would exclude the workers. None of the cited sources takes up this statement, so this is a low-confidence reading of the general outlook.

reification.rationale: Marxist commodity fetishism, not explicitly in sources.

racial-franchise.rationale: Limiting votes by race contradicts class internationalism and democracy.

interfaith-marriage-restriction.rationale: Legal restrictions by religion contradict the secular outlook of a communist movement.

boycott-minority-shops.rationale: Communal boycotts cut against working-class solidarity across ethnic lines.

citizens-assembly.rationale: A modern deliberative device, absent from the sources.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: The Marxist critique of capital power underlies its description of the Greek state as a bourgeois dictatorship, though liberty is phrased in liberal terms.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: Marxists oppose religion but split on state promotion.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: Marxists treat charity as a palliative; the movement aimed at replacing the system, not private relief.

shared-marital-authority.rationale: The communist tradition supports equality within marriage, though the group's own stance is undocumented.

uniformed-youth.rationale: Drilled national youth movements are associated with fascism and nationalism, which the movement opposed, though the topic is undiscussed.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: The Marxist theory of exploitation holds that income from ownership rather than labour is unearned, and the movement worked from it.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: The movement spoke of civil war and revolutionary struggle and was not pacifist.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: Nationalist continuity myths contradict the class and internationalist outlook.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: The movement commemorated revolution not nation; undocumented.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: A spiritual reading of politics contradicts historical materialism.

economy-in-majority-hands.rationale: Ethnic economic nationalism contradicts class internationalism.

independent-unions.rationale: The resolution opposes the KKE's pseudo-trade union organisations and demands independent unified revolutionary unions.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: Karliaftis says Stalin's regime destroyed democracy and workers' control, thus not socialist power.

local-essentials-public.rationale: The movement's programme followed Comintern demands to nationalise key industries and utilities.

second-chamber.rationale: The soviet model, which the movement defended, has no second chamber.

confederal-coordination.rationale: Confederal municipalism is an anarchist model, and the movement favoured a centralised revolutionary party.

racial-group-interests.rationale: Race-based organising contradicts the class organisation that Karliaftis describes.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: The group favours civil war over imperialist war but not pacifist.

communal-electorates.rationale: Separate religious electorates contradict secular class politics.

foreign-partition-plot.rationale: Nulled (statement review, 2026-11-12): its rationale rests on whether a foreign plot is believed to exist, or on foreign hostility in general rather than territorial partition, and the statement now asks whether preventing foreign-backed partition should be a central aim of national policy.

reviewHistory.rationale: Conspiratorial nationalism contradicts the materialist and internationalist analysis in the sources.
reviewHistory.author: claude-sonnet-5-5

reviewHistory.rationale: Nulled (statement review, 2026-11-12): its rationale rests on whether a foreign plot is believed to exist, or on foreign hostility in general rather than territorial partition, and the statement now asks whether preventing foreign-backed partition should be a central aim of national policy.

open-diplomacy.rationale: Bolshevik tradition of publishing secret treaties, from the first four Comintern congresses framework.

state-arms-monopoly.rationale: The Trotskyist programme supports workers' militias, so a state monopoly on arms is not endorsed, though undiscussed.

soldiers-refuse-war.rationale: Calls for turning imperialist war into civil war.

fiscal-rules-binding.rationale: Binding legal limits on borrowing contradict a planned economy under a workers' state.

smash-state-machine.rationale: Leninist doctrine from the first four Comintern congresses; the group sought soviet power.

free-economic-experiment.rationale: The movement stood for a planned socialist economy, not a pluralist laissez-faire of systems.

sacred-nation.rationale: The movement rejected the national framing and any mystique of nation in favour of class.

religions-one-truth.rationale: A materialist movement treats religion as ideology, not as truth.

workers-own-party.rationale: The 1930 congress considered building a new communist party independent of the KKE and condemned the bourgeois government.

customary-chiefs-lawmaking.rationale: Hereditary authority in lawmaking contradicts soviet democracy.

democracy-is-procedure.rationale: Karliaftis defends workers' democracy not procedural.

women-suffrage.rationale: Votes for women were a standard demand of the communist movement in the Comintern tradition.

religion-oppresses-women.rationale: Marxists differed on religion's role in women's oppression and the group did not address it.

homestead-ownership.rationale: First-claim ownership of land contradicts the movement's socialised property.

scripture-inerrant.rationale: A materialist movement rejects scriptural inerrancy.

defend-planned-state.rationale: Karliaftis says the Trotskyists were defenders of the Soviet Union, while the 1930 resolution calls for true and positive defence of the Soviet state.

minority-territorial-autonomy.rationale: The group rejected a Macedonian independence slogan; stance on autonomy unrecorded.

no-business-privileges.rationale: The movement opposed capitalist property and state favours for the bourgeoisie; privileges for well-connected business would be rejected.

no-denominational-politics.rationale: Marxists are secular and class-based, so religious denominational politics is opposed.

distribution-by-process.rationale: A Marxist group in the Left Opposition tradition sees capitalist wealth as extracted from workers, so fairness of process does not justify it.

labour-theory-of-value.rationale: As a Marxist current inside the Comintern and Left Opposition framework, it takes the labour theory of value from Marx as its base.

patriotism-serves-workers.rationale: The movement adopted Trotsky's internationalism and opposed patriotic Stalinist and national lines in favour of world revolution.

market-under-party-rule.rationale: The movement defended the Soviet state but opposed Stalinist party rule and demanded workers' democracy and soviets, so party-led market building is not its line.

former-empire-equal-treatment.rationale: Seeking influence in former imperial territories is imperialist and contrary to the movement's stance. (Carried over from former-empire-influence, "A country should cultivate political and cultural influence in regions once ruled by its predecessor empire.", with the value reversed, 2026-11-11.)

missingStatements.text: A revolutionary organisation should train its members in theory before leading mass action.
missingStatements.rationale: The movement's motto was first education and then action, and until 1926 it opposed mass demonstrations and unionism.
missingStatements.declined: Specific to the Archeio movement's study-first doctrine; too narrow for the bank.

missingStatements.text: Revolutionaries should build a unified union organisation independent of the established communist party rather than party-controlled rival unions.
missingStatements.rationale: The 1930 resolution opposes the KKE's pseudo-trade-union organisations and calls for an independent unified revolutionary trade union organisation.

notes: Only a handful of answers rest on direct statements in the cited texts; most are inferred from the Left Opposition and Comintern framework. The later KAKE, which allied with the right, would answer very differently on communism and the state.
